reference: UK September 2000 Ford Puma standard 1.7i 16V VCT coupe, FWD five-speed manual, RHD; not Racing Puma, Puma Black, 1.4/1.6 or modern Puma SUV
status: Source-ready with explicit mass-convention and workshop-coverage qualifications; simulation parameters remain estimates
duplicateCheck: No Puma or Racing Puma reference found in current catalog research or shared car-next JSON/Markdown packets before selection.

sources.type: OEM UK sales brochure hosted by independent archive
sources.verification: Actual pages 14, 15 and 20 rendered and visually inspected. Final page identifies Ford Motor Company Limited, FA1260/14, 09.2000. Archive filename 2001 does not override actual September 2000 publication date.

sources.type: OEM workshop material mirrored as HTML, coverage June 1997–December 2001
sources.verification: Read engine table; corroborates brochure output and displacement. No exact serial-number breakpoint independently checked.

sources.type: OEM workshop material mirrored as HTML, coverage June 1997–December 2001
sources.verification: Read 1.7-specific ratio column, not 1.4 column. Published precision is two decimal places; do not invent tooth-exact extra digits.

engine.layout: Naturally aspirated gasoline inline four, DOHC 16-valve VCT
engine.note: 125 PS is metric horsepower, not 125 mechanical hp. The workshop oil-pressure test at 850 rpm does not verify idle speed.

drivetrain.ratioStatus: Physical gearbox/final values published to two decimals in 1.7-specific OEM workshop mirror covering the selected date; exact tooth counts and finer precision not verified.
drivetrain.differential: Not verified; do not claim LSD.

mass.convention: OEM footnote: Represents the lightest kerbweight assuming full fluid levels, subject to manufacturing tolerances and options, etc., fitted.
mass.driverConvention: Not explicitly specified. Do not add or subtract 75 kg or substitute a secondary 1109 kg figure.

wheels.radiusDerivation: (195 mm * 0.50 + 15 in * 25.4 mm/in / 2) / 1000. Geometric unloaded radius, not measured loaded rolling radius.
wheels.avoid: Puma Black F1-style wheel design and aftermarket sizes are not selected.

chassis.rearSuspension: Twist beam / semi-trailing arms with coil springs, brochure wording
chassis.assists: ABS with EBD and low-speed traction control listed standard; precise control behavior not verified.

publishedPerformance.source: Actual September 2000 brochure page 14; retain source rather than replacing with earlier or secondary performance claims.

implementationNotes: Supported conventional ICE FWD manual model; no hybrid or selectable-drive mechanism needed.
All unknown physics fields must be explicitly marked estimates and launch-tested, not represented as OEM facts.
Original fictional artwork, no Ford/Puma badges or copied design; RHD cockpit consistent with selected UK market.
